ppltrades.message.api_unreachable: [PPLTrades] The price server is unreachable — Cloudflare may be blocked by your ISP. Enable a VPN/system proxy or set proxy in config/ppltrades.json. Collected prices are kept and will be sent later.
ppltrades.message.api_unreachable.proxy: [PPLTrades] The price server is unreachable both via the proxy and directly. Check your VPN/proxy or add a mirror to mirrorUrls in config/ppltrades.json. Collected prices are kept and will be sent later.
ppltrades.message.no_pochatok: The Pochatok mod is required to search signs
ppltrades.message.no_signsearchmask: Pochatok's regex search command isn't available. Check the installed version.
ppltrades.config.title: PPLTrades Settings
ppltrades.config.show_prices.tooltip: Show price statistics in tooltips while holding Shift on PepeLand.
ppltrades.config.collect_prices.tooltip: Send item details, coordinates, and sign text from opened shop barrels to the price service.
ppltrades.config.api_url.tooltip: Use an HTTPS base URL without credentials, query parameters, or fragment. Leave blank to disable fetching and sending price data. URL changes take effect after restarting the game.
ppltrades.config.api_url.invalid: Enter a valid https:// URL without credentials, query parameters, or fragment, or leave it blank.
ppltrades.config.aliases.tooltip: Enter one alias per line as “item ID = name”. Repeat the item ID to add more aliases.
ppltrades.config.trigger.tooltip: Key that reveals the category and prices in item tooltips.
ppltrades.config.trigger_hint.tooltip: Gray "Hold Shift for prices" line when the item has prices but the key isn't held.
ppltrades.config.layout.tooltip: Table — aligned columns, easy to compare periods. Compact — one line per period.
ppltrades.config.unit.tooltip: Auto — cheap stackable items per stack, everything else per item.
ppltrades.config.columns.tooltip: The first enabled price is the main one: highlighted and compared with the previous period.
ppltrades.config.col.median.tooltip: Typical price: half of the listings are cheaper, half are pricier. Robust to outliers.
ppltrades.config.col.min.tooltip: The cheapest listing in the period.
ppltrades.config.col.listings.tooltip: How many different barrels gave a price — more means more reliable.
ppltrades.config.merge_windows.tooltip: Show one "Hour–week" row when several periods have the same prices.
ppltrades.config.trend.tooltip: Price over the previous period of the same length: red ▲ — pricier, green ▼ — cheaper.
ppltrades.config.proxy.tooltip: system — system proxy (Windows / HTTPS_PROXY), none — direct, or http://127.0.0.1:10809. HTTP proxies only. Falls back to a direct connection.
ppltrades.config.proxy.invalid: Enter system, none or http://host:port (SOCKS is not supported).
ppltrades.config.mirrors.tooltip: HTTPS URLs are tried in order when the main address is unreachable (e.g. Cloudflare is blocked).
ppltrades.config.notify_unreachable.tool: Post a chat message when the price server is unreachable. Collected prices are kept either way.
ppltrades.config.search_overlay.tooltip: Toast in the screen corner after starting a sign search: the item name or the actual filter (regex for Pochatok).
ppltrades.config.need_cloth.title: Cloth Config is required for settings
ppltrades.config.need_cloth.message: The PPLTrades settings screen is built with the Cloth Config mod. Install it (Fabric, for your Minecraft version) and restart the game. Without it the mod uses config/ppltrades.json.
ppltrades.info.load_failed: Failed to load: price server unreachable
ppltrades.info.listings_hint: listings: %s · click to highlight the barrel
ppltrades.info.unit.tooltip: Switch the price: per item or per stack
ppltrades.info.site.tooltip: Open the item page on the website
ppltrades.info.highlighted: Barrel %s highlighted (visible through walls), coordinates copied. Click again or open the barrel to clear
ppltrades.message.searching_signs.title: Sign search
ppltrades.message.api_restored: [PPLTrades] Connection to the price server restored
ppltrades.update.available: [PPLTrades] A new version %s is available (you have %s).
ppltrades.config.notify_updates.tooltip: Once per game launch, post a chat message about a new mod version with a download link.
